item.title: Middle East Eye: Saudi air strikes kill more than 30 horses in Sanaa, Saba reports
item.description: Saudi air strikes kill more than 30 horses in Sanaa, Saba reports Five Saudi air strikes hit a stable in Yemen’s capital today, killing more than 30 thoroughbred horses, the Saba news agency reports. The stable stands in Bir Zaher, within Sanaa’s Bani al-Harith district. A local source told the agency that rubble still trapped other horses. Horses hold a prized place in Yemeni heritage as symbols of prestige and skilled horsemanship, with thoroughbreds also carrying considerable financial value.

item.description: Saudi strikes on Yemen buses and trucks leave 25 dead or missing: Report Saudi aircraft struck buses and trucks in Wadi Maabaq in Yemen’s Lahj governorate, leaving 25 people dead or missing and wounding six, the Saba news agency reports. item.title: Middle East Eye: Israeli army storms Syrian village
item.description: Israeli army storms Syrian village Israeli forces equipped with military vehicles stormed and searched homes in the village of Abidin, in Syria’s Deraa governorate.
